_comment: Per-run / per-journey proof galleries that live OUTSIDE the canonical multi-journey index — heavy chains whose pass-videos are produced by a dedicated workflow (e.g. alpenflight-proof-fanout.yml) and deployed to a namespaced subpath under /alpenflight/proof/. generate-gallery.mjs renders these as a 'Per-run proof galleries' nav block on the canonical index so they stay reachable across regeneration. `href` is relative to /alpenflight/proof/. Add an entry when a journey ships a heavy-chain gallery; leaf galleries themselves are generated with --no-nav.

galleries.note: real legacy → migrate + Keycloak → AlpenFlight, with the legacy create video & per-club AlpenFlight fan-out videos
